subject.title: feat: add human-readable channel display titles

question: Should ClickClack permanently expose a separate presentation-only `display_title` channel contract across its database schema, HTTP/OpenAPI API, SDK, and web UI?
rationale: This is a new persisted and public API field rather than a repair to an established behavior; implementation quality cannot decide the durable product and compatibility contract.

options.title: Accept the channel-title contract
options.body: Approve the additive field and require final fresh-install and existing-database validation evidence before merge.

options.title: Keep slugs as the only channel title
options.body: Decline the additional public field and preserve the existing `name`-only model.

options.title: Narrow the feature surface
options.body: Accept display titles only after reducing or revising the public API scope to match a defined integration need.

recommendation.title: Accept the channel-title contract
recommendation.body: Approve the additive field and require final fresh-install and existing-database validation evidence before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence identifies this person as the feature proposer and implementation author, though current-main ownership could not be independently traced.
